rules.title: Policy Order to Ban Algorithmic Rent-Setting Software
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order directing the city manager to work with city departments to draft an ordinance banning residential property management companies from using algorithmic or AI-driven rent-pricing software.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential property management companies using algorithmic/AI rent pricing services; specific ordinance language not yet drafted.
rules.citation: Cambridge, MA City Council Policy Order (2026)
rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: Whether the property manager contracts with an algorithmic/AI rent-pricing company

rules.conflict_note: This is a policy order directing staff to draft future ordinance language, not an enacted or formally introduced ordinance; final text, scope, and effective date are not yet determined.

rules.title: Massachusetts Bills Banning Algorithmic Rent-Setting
rules.requirement: Bills are pending in the Massachusetts House and Senate that would ban the use of algorithmic or AI-driven rent-setting software in the rental market statewide.
rules.coverage_conditions: Statewide; applies to use of algorithmic/AI pricing software by landlords or property managers (specific scope not detailed in this text).
